identity: Copperfell digs the copper Dur Brannoc runs on; bandits waylay the ore carts and a goblin foreman has opened an unlicensed dig above the seams.

quests.title: The Surveyor Has Tusks
quests.text: I paid a surveyor to mark our claims, and the Rooters have submitted their own revisions. Kill eight of them by day in the {name:lower_pines}, which lie {zone_area:lower_pines}. We cannot run a mine on measurements taken by snout.
quests.lesson: Home zone neutrals; levels rise from the Hearthpine border.

quests.title: Keep the Rails Together
quests.text: Hear that clatter from the workyard? That's what a rail sounds like when its clamps have had enough. Bring me four Iron Bars and four Coal Lumps for replacements, and I'll give you an Iron Pickaxe for the harder rock below.
quests.lesson: Iron ore to bar; the Iron Pickaxe opens the next rock tier.

quests.title: An Appetite for Figures
quests.text: A Packrat ate six months of accounts last night and left the cover, which I consider criticism. Kill eight Packrats in the {name:lower_pines} after dark. Those books record what the miners are owed, and teeth are no excuse for missing wages.

quests.title: A Handle on the Problem
quests.text: Half the workyard is sharing one sound handle, and the other half is waiting to borrow it. Bring me three Ridged Boar Tusks from Rooters in the {name:lower_pines} by day; any you saved will do. I'll see to the fitting, you see to the tusks.
quests.lesson: Save signature loot from earlier hunts.

quests.title: Orrik Sends Useful Hands
quests.text: Speak to Mara Deepwatch at Copperfell Outpost and tell her Orrik sent you; her latest request for help uses the word 'urgent' hard enough to tear the paper. I'd send a clerk, but she was quite specific about the axe.

quests.title: The Road Has Gone Hollow
quests.text: A cart wheel went through the ground, and I've no wish to see a carter follow it. Hunt eight Burrow Gnawers after dark on the {name:pine_slopes}, which lie {zone_area:pine_slopes}. They tunnel while we sleep; tonight we interrupt the shift.
quests.lesson: Night hunt beside a day hunt in the same belt.

quests.title: Sure Feet, Falling Slate
quests.text: Surefoot Ibex never seem to fall, but everything they stand on does. Cull eight on the {name:pine_slopes} by day before another load of slate comes down on the carters.
quests.lesson: Daytime work while the gnawers sleep.

quests.title: A Toll Paid in Bruises
quests.text: The last carter to refuse their 'road toll' came back without his cart. Go to the {name:bandit_camp} {dir_from_giver:bandit_camp} and defeat eight outlaws in all, counting Footpads and Bandit Lookouts. Use cover to close on the lookouts; an arrow doesn't care how stout your argument is.
quests.lesson: Melee and ranged outlaws in one camp.

quests.title: One Carter Still Missing
quests.text: Tovin Ashthumb hasn't come home, and I won't write his name under lost cargo. He's still a captive at the bandit camp you just raided; go speak with him while their watch is thin. He may know where the ore went, but first let him know we remembered him.

quests.title: The Guild's Good Name
quests.text: Every load we approve bears the guild seal, and I won't carve our name into rubbish. Bring me two pieces of Rough Jade from deep beneath the foothills, below the copper. Take your Iron Pickaxe, mind your light, and leave yourself a way back. I'd rather wait for the seal than replace the miner.
quests.lesson: Gems by depth; the iron pick reaches tier two rock.

quests.title: I Know Where They Sold It
quests.text: They tied my hands, not my ears; I heard the bandits selling our ore to the goblins at the {name:goblin_dig} {dir_from_giver:goblin_dig}. Defeat eight of the dig's guards in all, counting Rubble Slingers and Ore-Guard Hounds. The slingers throw rocks and the hounds rush in, so don't let one distract you from the other.
quests.lesson: A goblin camp: ranged slingers with a melee hound.

quests.title: Our Wages, Nog's Problem
quests.text: Goblin Foreman Nog pays his crew out of Stolen Purses, which makes every carter here an unwilling investor. Bring back three of those purses from the Rubble Slingers at the {name:goblin_dig} and kill Nog himself there; draw him away from his crew if you can, because I'd like our wages back without owing you a funeral. And look at the purses before you hand them over: goblins don't stamp their money, but somebody stamped these.
quests.lesson: Normal named leader at a camp; pull him alone.

quests.title: A Familiar Stamp
quests.text: That stamp on Nog's purses belongs to a Dur Brannoc counting-house; someone in the capital has been putting a respectable seal on rotten business. Follow the main road there and tell Dorrin Gateledger what we found. He keeps the gate's ledger, and nothing will offend him more than our own seal on stolen ore.
